newsitem.title: USA: Pa. voters mull Tuesday bond ballots, primaries.
newsitem.headline: Pa. voters mull Tuesday bond ballots, primaries.

text.p: Voters in Pennsylvania will go to the polls Tuesday to consider two large bond issues and numerous local elections.
The bond questions include a $59 million proposal in Bucks County to finance the purchase and preservation of open spaces.
Philadelphia voters will decide on a $121.9 million bond question for capital improvements.
Philadelphia's Democratic controller Jonathan Saidel is in a heated primary race against challenger Andre Dasent. The winner will face Republican William O'Brien, who is unopposed in the primary.
